description: Session is busy. Plugin coordinator holds the item in its local durable ledger and defers prompt_async until session reaches idle at a safe boundary.

expected_protocol_sequence.note: Plugin detects busy; persists item in local ledger. Does NOT call prompt_async.
Plugin observes session-idle event at safe boundary.
Plugin checks history for palliumRelayId before submitting (restart safety).

race_guard: Plugin serializes on session-idle event; does not use status-then-prompt (TOCTOU race).
forbidden: GET /session/status followed immediately by POST /prompt_async without atomic idle check
Calling prompt_async while session reports busy
